name: Weapons and CBRN
definition: Requests to create, obtain, or deploy weapons, explosives, or chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear agents.

name: Cyber Intrusion and Malware
definition: Requests to gain unauthorized access to systems, or to create malware, exploits, or hacking tools.

name: Illegal Drugs
definition: Requests to synthesize, obtain, or traffic illegal drugs or controlled substances.

name: Self Harm and Suicide
definition: Requests for methods of, or encouragement toward, self-harm or suicide.

name: Child Sexual Exploitation
definition: Any sexual content involving minors, or facilitation of child sexual abuse.

name: Fraud and Financial Crime
definition: Schemes to defraud, scam, launder money, or commit theft or financial crime.

name: Terrorism and Violent Extremism
definition: Planning, supporting, or inciting terrorism or violent extremism.

name: Privacy Violation and Doxxing
definition: Obtaining or exposing private personal information about individuals without consent.
